question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

23, 25, 28, 33, ?, 51, 64
solution:
The logic followed here is: The consecutive prime number series is added to each successive term given in the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27e28a18ec4aebb444db898bb47104aabc44a793e67c956072c564fc544b9f07.png] 

thus, "40" will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".
